title: Metric Source Completions and Integrability in Celestial Gravity
summary: We study metric-source responses of celestial Einstein amplitudes while retaining their momentum-conservation distribution. The consecutive opposite-helicity response is related to the simultaneous gravitational contact at arbitrary hard multiplicity. Their difference contains a Lorentz transformation that annihilates the conservation delta function, determining the normal recoil contribution and its relation to the undifferentiated coefficient.
